svg.title: Three heat maps of predicted reliability per band and UTC hour for the path to Guinea, for FT8 at 25 W, CW at 20 W and SSB at 25 W, with my five QSOs marked. FT8 is open on 40 and 30 m at night and on 20 to 10 m for most of the day. CW is somewhat smaller. SSB at 25 W stays dark green to black almost everywhere: on a typical day the model gives it little chance, and both my SSB QSOs fall in such cells.
